findings.description: ADR-SAG-0022 is Active and says the sc-jev-py test-util feature 'adds keyword-only scripted_answers to run_check', that 'cargo test ... compiles the Python signature with cfg(test)', and that 'sprint a-8 pytest may enable it'. The code no longer does this. run_check has one signature with no scripted_answers parameter. Scripted injection is the separate Python function sc_jev_py._testing.run_check_scripted, registered only under feature test-util (crates/sc-jev-py/src/lib.rs:83-87, crates/sc-jev-py/src/run.rs:518-574). The code does not match the binding ADR text. The ADR also does not mention that ScriptedJudge and RequestLog are now pub under sc-jev-check test-util (crates/sc-jev-check/src/registry/mod.rs:17-27). Note: this change moves toward ADR-SAG-0011, ADR-SAG-0009 and the ADR-SAG-0022 intent (production run_check has no scripted parameter), but an ADR is changed only by a later ADR. Also stale: docs/architecture.md:156-163.
findings.remediation: Add an ADR (or amendment, e.g. ADR-SAG-0023 amending ADR-SAG-0022) that records the _testing submodule with run_check_scripted, the single run_check signature, the pub ScriptedJudge/RequestLog under sc-jev-check test-util, and shorthand normalisation inside register_scripted_backends. Update the ADR index. This must be Active or Approved before merge.

findings.description: ADR-SAG-0020 (Active) says 'Cargo feature test-util exposes the in-memory doubles MapEnv and MapKeyring'. sc-agent-secrets no longer has a test-util feature (crates/sc-agent-secrets/Cargo.toml has no [features]). MapEnv and MapKeyring are #[cfg(test)] only (crates/sc-agent-secrets/src/resolve.rs:214-216) and are not exported from lib.rs:69-76. The ADR's extension-point wording no longer matches the crate. Same drift in the same ADR: docs/architecture.md:395-396 says ResolvedApiKey::as_str is the only read and a transport may call it. The code now enforces this with clippy disallowed-methods plus two #[allow(..., reason)] sites, but the ADR does not record the clippy rule or the try_new constructor.
findings.remediation: Amend ADR-SAG-0020 by a later ADR. It should record that the doubles are crate-private cfg(test) code with no feature, that ResolvedApiKey::try_new is the one construction rule set, and that clippy.toml disallowed-methods restricts as_str to the two sending transports (crates/sc-jev/src/client/https.rs:84-88, crates/sc-jev-backends/src/transport.rs:81-85).

findings.description: The boundary manifest facade still lists sc_agent_secrets::MapEnv and MapKeyring, and notes (line 25) say they are 'behind the test-util feature'. Neither is exported and the feature no longer exists. The manifest is stale versus Cargo.toml and lib.rs. Dependency lists (allowed_dependencies, forbidden_edges) do match Cargo.toml. Boundary correctness itself belongs to ruthless-boundary-qa. I report it as a stale structural artifact.
findings.remediation: Remove MapEnv and MapKeyring from the facade and correct the notes.

findings.description: ADR-SAG-0016 text says sc-observability-types = "1.5.0" and sc-observability = "1.5.0". Workspace Cargo.toml:39-40 hoists both as "=1.5.0" (docs/architecture.md:30 already says =1.5.0). The version-form drift predates this PR and is covered by D8, which is not implemented here. The substance holds: sc-observability-types is only in sc-agent-types, and full sc-observability only in sc-ai and sc-jev-py.
findings.remediation: Resolve with the D8 ADR amendment of the version text. No code change.
